title: What If Our Big Bang Wasn't the Only One?

author: StarTalk
description:
If something is possible, has the universe tried it? Are all physical possibilities inevitable? Neil deGrasse Tyson sits down with theoretical astrophysicist Janna Levin to launch “In Theory,” a new StarTalk series celebrating the weird, wacky theories of the universe and the theorists who chase them. Out on YouTube October 29, 2026!

What if nature has already tried every experiment the laws of physics allow? We explore whether every solar system combination has been attempted, if our big bang is the only big bang, and if there are multiple universes, do they collide and overlap? We discuss why theorists sometimes wait centuries for vindication and whether the laws of physics were just a roll of the dice.
